title: Change weakens its own policy
summary: A change adds a literal gray to the form styles and, in the same commit, downgrades the color rule from "block" to "report" in the policy file.
whyItMatters: If the policy under review comes from the change itself, any rule can be switched off by the change it should catch. Loading the policy from the base branch (--policy-ref) keeps the gate intact, and the policy edit is always reported for owner review.
